verdict.rationale: First-party enterprise-readiness docs say the platform has completed a SOC 2 Type II audit, with the report available via the Trust Center. A HIPAA-compliant pipeline with a BAA is offered to Enterprise customers. BYOC/self-hosting on Kubernetes keeps document data inside your own infrastructure, which partly substitutes for a retention guarantee, but no zero-retention or no-storage policy for uploaded documents on the managed service is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit zero-retention/data-deletion policy for uploaded documents, HIPAA availability beyond the Enterprise tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the compliance claims.
